description: Office for a marketing team in Warsaw, 183 m²: layout option 1 and 3D visualizations under the “Express” design package by DUMSKAYA DESIGN.
h1: Office interior design for a marketing team in Warsaw, 183 m²

blocks.text: Office interior design for a marketing team in Warsaw, 183 m²

parts.html: DUMSKAYA DESIGN designed the interior of a 183 m² office in Warsaw for a marketing team under the “Express” design package: layout option 1 with a furniture plan and photorealistic 3D visualizations of all the main rooms.

The office is built for a large team and lively collaboration: a spacious open-plan area, an open-type office, the “Financiers” office, a meeting room and a separate executive office. Reception with a waiting area serves clients and guests, while a game zone and a kitchen-dining area give the team room to unwind.

The palette is calm and warm: light walls, grey-brown carpet, natural wood in the custom furniture and living greenery. Each zone has its own accent: soft rounded armchairs at reception, orange chairs and a blue panel in the office with the world map, green chairs in the kitchen, bean bag chairs and a TV in the game zone.
The executive office has a desk, a TV area and soft armchairs for informal meetings.

The “Express” package is a fast design project without a full set of working drawings: a measured floor plan, a furniture layout and 3D visualization. If you need detailed drawings for renovation, compare the packages on the prices page.
The project is developed remotely, while renovation and furniture in Warsaw are handled by the studio’s partners — see the “Interior design in Warsaw” page for details.

The working part of the office has two large zones: a 72.34 m² open-plan area and a 25.84 m² open-type office. Next to them are the “Financiers” office, the meeting room and the executive office. The entrance group combines reception and the game zone, while the kitchen-dining area is a separate room. The workstations are arranged with circulation routes, functional zones and the way the office will be used in mind.
